**1. Recommended base: St. Pete Beach, FL (TPA)**

Stay on the Gulf for all 4 nights. Do the Corvette day as one inland excursion to **Circuit Florida** in Auburndale (I-4 Exit 44).

Why this pairing:
- There is **no production “Corvette ZRX1.”** No Florida public program lists a **ZR1**. Closest real public track cars are **C8 Z06** and **C8 Z51 Stingray**.

- **TPA** is ~25–40 min from St. Pete Beach vs MCO (theme-park, weaker beach).
- One hotel the whole stay. Split stay not justified.

Runner-up: Cocoa Beach + MCO if they prefer Atlantic/space coast. Same track, similar drive.

**2. Corvette experience (book this first)**

**Primary (fits these dates)**  
- **Name:** Superspeed Orlando at Circuit Florida  
- **Car:** Chevrolet **Corvette C8 Z06** (~670–680 hp, 5.5L LT6, 0–60 ~2.6s). Also **C8 Z51 Stingray**. **ZR1 not listed.**  
- **Address:** 150 Raceway Dr, Auburndale, FL 33823  
- **Nearest airport:** TPA ~50–60 min; MCO ~40–50 min  
- **When:** **Wednesday, Oct 21, 2026**, morning slot (8:00 a.m.–noon). Midweek, after Monday arrival, before Friday departure. Drives listed 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; plan ~1.5–2 hours on site.  
- **Price (per driver, not per couple):**  
  - Z06: 2 orientation laps + **3 driven laps** (~5 miles); optional 4th lap **$99+**. Reseller **Adrenaline365: $418/person**. Official site did not return a live Z06 sticker (page timeout). Homepage example: Ferrari 296 GTB **$549**.  
  - **Corvette Z51 Track Experience: $995** — 12 total laps, pro coach, helmet, insurance. Best “race it” option.  
  - Included insurance (FAQ): **$50,000** vehicle / **$10,000** deductible; upgrade **$65** → $100k / $5k.  
  - Onboard video add-on **$79**.  
- **Requirements:** Drive = **18+** and **valid physical license** (US or foreign). Ride-along = **11+** and **4′11″**. Closed-toe flat shoes. English for in-car coaching (Spanish/Portuguese by request, **$25**).  
- **Oct 2026 slots:** Not confirmed live (booking calendar timed out). FAQ: open **almost every week**, reserve **up to 6 months** (this trip is ~8 weeks out — inside the window). If calendar is empty: **863-247-6900, option 3** or info@superspeedorlando.com.  
- **URLs:** https://superspeedorlando.com/experiences/ · https://superspeedorlando.com/booknow/ · https://circuitflorida.com/exotic-car-experiences/

**Not ZR1 / not these dates (do not book as the Oct 19–23 plan)**  
- **Xtreme Xperience C8 Z06** Homestead: next **Dec 7–10, 2026**. Circuit Florida: **Dec 17–20, 2026**. From **$299–$389** + mandatory protection **$39–$129**. Age/height: Z06 max **6′4″**, 350 lb. https://www.thextremexperience.com/tracks/homestead-miami-speedway  
- **Sports Car Driving Experience** 2023 C8 Z51: **$2,600** + optional insurance **$375**. Sebring **Oct 2** and **Nov 6, 2026** (8 a.m.–4 p.m.). No Oct 19–23 date. https://sportscardrivingexperience.com/  
- **NASCAR Racing Experience Homestead Oct 17** — stock car, not a Corvette.  
- **Palm Beach International Raceway** — closed (2022).  
- **Exotics Racing** — Las Vegas only.

Price as **1 driver + 1 spectator** (or ride-along). Second driver pays a second drive ticket.

All on or across from St. Pete Beach. Target **$180–$320/night before tax**. Official calendars for these exact dates did not load; figures are **recent/typical**, not invented live quotes.

Skip Don CeSar / luxury. Add ~12–15% FL tax + resort fee (often $30–$50/night). Budget **~$1,000–$1,400** room + tax for 4 nights.

Florida is **ET (EDT, UTC-4)**; SLC/DEN is **MT (MDT, UTC-6)** in October (DST until Nov 1, 2026). Times below are **local**.

**Recommended SLC (daytime Mon arrival so Oct 19 is usable)**  
- **Southwest, 1 stop AUS, 5h 50m:** leave SLC **6:20 a.m. MT Mon Oct 19** → TPA **2:10 p.m. ET**. **$427 RT.** Pair with SW return **4:00 p.m. ET Fri Oct 23** TPA → SLC **9:20 p.m. MT** via LAS (7h 20m) so Friday morning is still a beach half-day.  
  Book: https://www.southwest.com/ and https://www.google.com/travel/flights?q=Flights+from+SLC+to+TPA+on+2026-10-19+through+2026-10-23  
- **American, 1 stop DFW, 5h 56m:** SLC **8:25 a.m. MT** → TPA **4:21 p.m. ET**. **$577 RT.**  
- **Frontier via DEN (basic):** SLC **8:00 a.m.** → TPA **4:52 p.m.** **$333 RT.** Bags extra; tight on reliability.

**SLC nonstop (do not use as “arrive Oct 19”)**  
- **Delta DL2077:** SLC **11:55 p.m. MT Mon** → TPA **6:00 a.m. ET Tue**. **$557 RT.** Arrives **Oct 20**. Only useful if they fly **Sun Oct 18** night instead.  
- **Return nonstop Delta:** TPA **7:15 a.m. ET Fri** → SLC **10:03 a.m. MT**, ~4h 48m, **$399** on the one-way grid (kills Friday beach). Typical TPA–SLC nonstop is ~**6:45–7:15 a.m. ET**.

**DEN is better if origin can be Denver**  
- **Southwest nonstop:** DEN **5:00 a.m. MT** → TPA **10:20 a.m. ET**, 3h 20m, **$310 RT.** Best beach-day capture.  
- **United nonstop:** DEN **9:35 a.m.** → TPA **3:06 p.m.**, **$420 RT.**

Drive times: TPA→St. Pete Beach **25–40 min**; hotel→Circuit Florida **~80–100 min / ~75–90 mi** via I-275/I-4; TPA→track **50–60 min**.

**Mon Oct 19 — arrive + beach (day 1 of 3)**  
6:20 a.m. MT depart SLC. 2:10 p.m. ET land TPA. Rental. 3:00–4:00 p.m. hotel (early-bag drop if before 4). Sunset beach / Pass-a-Grille. Dinner: **The Hurricane**, 809 Gulf Way, https://thehurricane.com/ (lunch/dinner; rooftop 21+).

**Tue Oct 20 — full beach (day 2)**  
St. Pete Beach / Pass-a-Grille. Optional downtown St. Pete (Dali, ~25 min) only if they want a break from sand. Dinner: **RumFish Grill** at TradeWinds or **Salt Rock Grill** (Indian Shores, ~20 min).

**Wed Oct 21 — RACE, not a beach day**  
Leave hotel **by 7:00 a.m.** for a 9:00 a.m. slot (buffer for I-4). Closed-toe shoes, physical license, confirmation, signed waiver. 1.5–2 hours on site. Lunch nearby or back toward Tampa. Home **by ~2:00–3:30 p.m.** Do not stack a beach afternoon as a “beach day.” Optional **4th lap $99+** or video **$79**.

**Thu Oct 22 — full beach (day 3)**  
Unhurried Gulf day. Pack race shoes away.

**Fri Oct 23 — depart**  
If SW **4:00 p.m. TPA**: beach morning, checkout 11 a.m., leave hotel **by 1:00 p.m.** (30–40 min + return car + 90 min TSA). Arrive SLC **9:20 p.m. MT**.  
If Delta **7:15 a.m. TPA**: leave hotel **~5:00 a.m.** — no Friday beach.

**Weather / pack:** Late Oct Tampa normals ~**83°F / 68°F**, water ~**79°F**, ~6 rain days, 2.3 in month (NWS Tampa Oct normals). Hurricane season **through Nov 30**. Tampa’s historic October Caribbean-track risk is real; 2026 El Niño has been suppressing activity but **do not treat it as zero**. Refundable hotel/air + watch NHC. Pack: swimsuit, reef-safe sunscreen, light rain layer, closed-toe shoes for track, license, no sandals on track.

content.text: Official SuperSpeed page is blocking bots, so I’m using the live reseller numbers plus what we already confirmed.

text.content: For the Wednesday track day, these are the real public packages. Per driver, not per couple.

The 3-lap C8 Z06 at Circuit Florida is $418. That includes a coach in the car, helmet, a short safety class, and basic insurance. Expect about 2 hours on site (they run 8am–4pm). You must be 18+, have a physical license, and be under 6'3" / 350 lb. Cancel at least 7 days out for a refund.

Add-ons the day of: better insurance $50 ($85k / $4k deductible) or $120 ($125k / $2k), in-car video $65, photo/video pack $85, extra pit pass $10. Extra laps are usually ~$99 if they offer them that day.

The longer SuperSpeed Z51 “track experience” is about $995 for 12 laps with a coach. That is the more “I raced it” option. A second person driving pays a second ticket. Ride-alongs are much cheaper when they sell them (Hellcat ride-along is $89; Corvette ride-along was not listed live).

ZR1 and ZR1X have no public price because nobody sells a tourist seat in those cars.

One Z06 driver on this trip is about $418–$550 with add-ons, or ~$995 if you take the 12-lap Z51. Whole-trip ballpark for two people is still $3,300–$5,300. Nothing is purchased. [Book the 3-lap Z06](https://www.adrenaline365.com/orlando/supercars/corvette-c8-z06-3-lap-drive-circuit-florida-orlando/) if you want that one, and call SuperSpeed at 863-247-6900 option 3 to confirm they can run Oct 21 (the $418 listing is a touring fleet and may not be on site that Wednesday).
